scope.primary: Exhaustive Vulkan parity for every current non-reserved AMD AGS D3D shader intrinsic opcode.
scope.secondary: Exhaustive review and implementation of additional non-low-precision AMDGPU math/native opportunities not exposed by AGS.
scope.deferred_by_hardware: FP8/BF8/FP6/BF6/FP4 format conversion, packing and dot families are tracked but deferred until suitable test hardware is available. FP16/BF16 remain in scope.

ags_opcodes.spirv: SPV_AMD_shader_ballot SwizzleInvocationsMaskedAMD; AGS 15-bit control decodes as 5-bit AND/OR/XOR masks
ags_opcodes.note: Generic template accepts the AGS immediate rather than only named swap/reverse/broadcast aliases.

ags_opcodes.spirv: SPV_KHR_fragment_shader_barycentric BaryCoordKHR/BaryCoordNoPerspKHR for center/centroid/sample modes plus SPV_AMD_shader_explicit_vertex_parameter BaryCoordPullModelAMD for pull model
SPV_AMD_shader_explicit_vertex_parameter InterpolateAtVertexAMD, including compiler-native AGS D3D parameter-register/component index resolution independent of Vulkan Location
ags_opcodes.note: vk::AmdVertexParameter and vk::AmdVertexParameterComponent enforce AGS immediate index ranges and reproduce DXC prefix-stable D3D input-register packing before selecting the actual SPIR-V Input pointer.

ags_opcodes.spirv: OpGroupNonUniform* Reduce for add/mul/min/max float/int/uint and bitwise AND/OR/XOR int/uint; scalar and vector2/3/4 forms
OpGroupNonUniform* InclusiveScan/ExclusiveScan matching AGS postfix/prefix for add/mul/min/max float/int/uint; scalar and vector2/3/4 forms
vk::RawBufferLoad from a 64-bit physical device address can preserve the load, but the public AGS header does not specify whether its separate 32-bit offset argument is byte- or DWORD-scaled
ags_opcodes.note: Do not guess address + offset versus address + 4*offset.

ags_opcodes.spirv: Int64Atomics for structured buffers and SPV_EXT_shader_image_int64 Int64ImageEXT for typed 1D/2D/3D storage images; RWByteAddressBuffer 64-bit atomics remain blocked because the SPIR-V raw-buffer representation is an array of 32-bit uint words with no genuine 64-bit atomic pointee
ags_opcodes.note: Structured-buffer and image add/min/max/and/or/xor/exchange/CAS are native contracts. Raw 64-bit atomics must not be split into two 32-bit atomics; Min64/Max64 currently route toward the 32-bit raw atomic handler and are not claimed supported until a legal 64-bit representation/alignment bridge exists.

ags_opcodes.spirv: nearest-even value conversion is available through standard half packing; Vulkan FPRoundingMode can express RTN/RTP on OpFConvert only under storage-use restrictions that do not match AGS's returned F16-bit value contract
ags_opcodes.test: half conversion probe + future rounding-boundary corpus
ags_opcodes.note: Directional round-to-F16-as-bits remains missing exact Vulkan ingress. Do not replace it with software bit emulation and call it native.

ags_opcodes.spirv: device-scope OpReadClockKHR provides a device-consistent clock value but SPV_KHR_shader_clock explicitly does not provide AGS's code-motion-barrier semantics
ags_opcodes.test: amd.intrinsics.shader-clock.hlsl exercises DeviceClockNoBarrier only as qualification instrumentation
ags_opcodes.note: Do not label DeviceClockNoBarrier as ShaderRealtimeClock parity.

low_level_math.surface: rcp / sqrt / rsq / sin / cos / log2 / exp2 / fract / tanh / pow / frexp / ldexp (non-legacy)
low_level_math.amd_native: AMD native transcendental/decomposition families where available
low_level_math.spirv: standard mathematical SPIR-V/GLSL.std.450 semantics with direct-vs-canonical empirical probes
low_level_math.note: Promote individual spellings only after installed-driver ISA and numerical qualification.
Ordinary reciprocal/multiply/FMA is not equivalent; do not emulate or relabel.
